changelog.v2.2.0: Nice little update for y'all. Added art images to the games list, added a global action menu for downloading all missing art and now art can be found for nested folders. Also three bugfixes; bulk adding games to collections should be more reliable, redria7 added a robust system for keeping track of the last selected list item and toastd figured out why art could not be found for some games.

changelog.v2.4.1: Added clear recently played to the global actions tool. Thanks madeleineostoja for the suggestion!
changelog.v2.5.0: Added a new Play History tool allowing for viewing of all current game tracking history. Includes total hours, hours by console, hours by game, ROM location tagging, ROM collection tagging, a play summary screen, and a granular detail screen. Play summary and granular detail screens can also be accessed from game actions.
changelog.v2.6.0: Behind the scenes collection enhancements, fix for the art downloader missing exact name matches, you can now jump pages (D-Pad Left / Right) while reordering games in a collection and new option in the collection options screen to alphabetize the games.
changelog.v2.7.0: A new filtering option for the Play History Tool!
changelog.v2.7.1: Updated filter screen formatting to show the full time.
changelog.v2.8.0: Updated the system tag mappings to help find game art for more platforms.

changelog.v0.1.9: Reworked the centered catalog flow with reliable held scrolling and safer chapter jumps, improved article opening and parsing, and moved tg5040 haptics off the render path.

paks.name: Grampus
paks.description: ORCA-inspired grid sequencer paired with 9 built-in polyphonic synth engines: Drifter (dual-osc analog), Warper (wavetable), BrokenFM (6-operator FM), String (Karplus), ROMpler (sample kits), LoFiTron (tape-replay sustained instruments), WaveSurf (2D wavetable morph), SynDrums (kick/snare/clap/toms/cymbals with transient layer), and BoneSaw (Roland JP-8000 SuperSaw with per-saw hard sync). 8 scene slots per project let you switch between grids, params, and tempos mid-performance on tick-quantized boundaries so the music keeps flowing across the swap. New ^ Strum operator plays chord notes in arpeggiator-pattern order with sub-tick to multi-tick spacing, swing-aware. 10 filter modes including 3 Polivoks-inspired modelling filters with vocal diode-pair bite (PVox LP/HP/BP). 8 tracks, per-track LFOs and effects, master delay and reverb, WAV recording. Projects, recordings, and bundled demos live in the Grampus folder at the root of your SD Card. Full operator and instrument reference in MANUAL.md at https://github.com/boorch/grampus-pak/blob/main/MANUAL.md. Desktop builds (macOS / Linux / Windows) at https://boorch.itch.io/grampus.
paks.author: boorch (Bruce Menace/Cometary Trails)
